casts.name: Almost
casts.shows: You are nearly there, and the last stride is where it gets wet.
casts.image: ☵ water beneath ☲ fire. Every line sits in the wrong place, and the fire is climbing away from the water.
casts.situation: Before completion. Everything is out of position, and the figure is the last of the sixty-four, so the book ends one step short on purpose. The old image is a young fox crossing the ice and wetting its tail at the very end. Care is wanted exactly where the crossing looks finished.

becomes.name: Divergence
becomes.shows: You are going deeper and pushing forward at once, and the two cancel.
becomes.image: ☵ water beneath ☰ heaven. Heaven rises, water sinks. The two halves are travelling apart.
becomes.situation: Two forces inside one figure heading opposite ways, so the friction here is structural. The counsel is to stop at the halfway point and to decline the great river, because a dispute carried to its end costs more than whatever was in dispute.

casts.name: Incubation
casts.shows: What is true here is still inside the shell.
casts.image: ☱ lake beneath ☴ wind. Two yielding lines at the centre with firm ones closed around them: a hollow held warm.
casts.situation: The character shows a bird's claw over its young. The old image is a crane calling in the shade with its young answering, a signal that carries without being aimed anywhere. The counsel says pigs and fishes bring good fortune, which the commentary reads as sincerity reaching even the dullest creature.

becomes.name: Spending
becomes.shows: This has a price and you have yet to name it.
becomes.image: ☱ lake beneath ☶ mountain. The lake has been dug deeper so that the mountain can stand higher.
becomes.situation: Something has been taken from the base and added to the top. The old text asks how the offering should be made and answers that two small bowls will do, since the sacrifice counts by sincerity. Decrease that you choose is a different event from decrease that happens to you.

casts.name: Bearing
casts.shows: The whole weight of this is yours, unasked.
casts.image: ☷ earth beneath ☷ earth. Six broken lines. Every one of them has a gap at the centre.
casts.situation: Pure capacity to hold. The figure carries whatever is set on it and supplies no direction of its own. Its instruction is to follow, and that is how ground carries what is set on it. The image is a mare: strength that goes where it is pointed, for a very long way.

casts.name: Mutuality
casts.shows: The movement here arrived because you stopped.
casts.image: ☶ mountain beneath ☱ lake. The mountain holds a hollow at its summit; the lake settles into it.
casts.situation: Stillness underneath, openness above. Influence runs both ways here only because the lower party stopped moving long enough to be shaped. The classical note is that this works because the young man takes the position beneath the young woman.

casts.name: Molting
casts.shows: A skin is coming off you, and the new one is soft.
casts.image: ☲ fire beneath ☱ lake. Fire underneath water, two things in one figure that undo each other.
casts.situation: The character means hide, the animal skin, and by extension the shedding of one. The old text ties the change to a named day and says belief arrives after the change has happened. A molt gets trusted in retrospect.

becomes.image: ☲ fire beneath ☵ water. Every line in the figure sits in its correct place, with the water above the fire.
becomes.situation: After completion. This is the one figure where all six lines are correctly placed, which the tradition treats as the start of decline, since a thing entirely finished has one direction left to it. The old counsel gives good fortune at the outset and disorder at the end, and tells you to think about the trouble in advance.

casts.name: Thaw
casts.shows: The knot just loosened, and the window is short.
casts.image: ☵ water beneath ☳ thunder. The storm has broken and the rain is already coming down.
casts.situation: Release after held pressure. The old counsel is unusual in its urgency: if there is somewhere to go, go early; if the going is finished, come back and be quiet. Either way the instruction is speed, because a window a storm opens closes again.
